We are entirely run by volunteers (including parents) and we really welcome help to make the club run as smoothly as possible. That includes parents helping out on the desk at the start of sessions, and helping to put tables out at the start and clearing away at the end.

If you would like any more information or have suggestions please email us (cambridgechessgo at gmail dot com).
